verdicts_or_reports.expected: With the Videos filter active and no videos, the blank state should say something about videos (e.g. "No videos found"), matching the active filter badge "Videos".
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The blank state under the Videos filter shows "No photos found", while the filter badge reads "Videos" and the filter menu shows "Videos (0)".
steps: Open the Media tab (library holds 2 photos, big.jpg and huge.jpg).
Tap the Filter icon at top right; the menu shows Media (2), Photos (2), Videos (0).
Observe the blank state in the middle of the screen reads 'No photos found' and the header badge reads 'Videos'.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: One album "IrisSeed" with 2 items (big.jpg and huge.jpg) after both photos are restored from Trash.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Two separate "IrisSeed" album tiles appear, each with 1 item, one with cover huge.jpg and one with big.jpg.
steps: Start with IrisSeed holding big.jpg and huge.jpg (Albums shows one IrisSeed tile, '2 items').
Media tab: long-press huge.jpg, tap big.jpg, tap Delete; confirm the 'moved to Trash' snackbar.
Library > Trash: long-press one item, tap the other, tap 'Restore selected'. Snackbar says '2 items restored to gallery'.
Observe two IrisSeed tiles, each reading '1 items' (one with huge.jpg cover, one with big.jpg cover). Reproduced twice.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: In landscape, the album captions (name and item count) sit clear of the bottom navigation bar and can be read in full.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: In landscape the floating bottom navigation bar covers the second album's caption: the name "IrisSeed" is cut through and the "1 items" line is overdrawn by the bar.
steps: Make sure the Albums tab shows two IrisSeed tiles (one cover huge.jpg, one cover big.jpg).
Observe the bottom navigation bar overlaps the captions of the second album tile (the right-hand IrisSeed tile).
